title: Venus2 compatibility profile at RTL bf82d804

facts_and_observations.historical_note: The older two-bit proposal is stale for this RTL commit and is retained only as a historical mismatch counterexample.

value.reason: Current RTL-bound workloads must use backend-native value descriptors; logical-to-physical fit alone does not prove pointer-record semantics.

facts_and_observations.evidence: configs/backends/venus2p0-16x128.json and the CCH 61-port firmware handoff

facts_and_observations.value: Historical probes observed 96, 288 and 864-byte requests delivering only 64, 256 and 832 bytes; current practice aligns and initializes the final 64-byte beat.
facts_and_observations.restriction: Do not treat this as a cross-version rule or as fully refreshed current-commit evidence until a focused replay is completed.

facts_and_observations.evidence: The unshifted CCH handoff is RTL-exact 61/61; the historical shifted form aliased destinations.
facts_and_observations.restriction: Re-probe for a different RTL digest or Scheduler contract.

facts_and_observations.value: Retain the classified scratch store-to-dependent-load fences in the current PDCCH Polar tasks.
facts_and_observations.positive: C005/integrated retained-fence form is Gem5 and RTL 61/61 exact.
facts_and_observations.negative: C004 no-fence form is Gem5 57/61 with first mismatch at Task 9 port 3.
facts_and_observations.restriction: This does not establish a universal Venus2 scratch rule; an independent minimal probe remains required.

facts_and_observations.evidence: The active manifest enables completion polling and the current CCH fresh RTL run completes all 14 tasks.
facts_and_observations.restriction: Five generic Scheduler contract-test errors remain; do not treat this as a fully reviewed infrastructure contract.

facts_and_observations.value: Large retained vectors around vcmxmul and aggressive full-Z unrolling produced register-allocation, Venus-merge, VNS or venusplit failures in recorded candidates.
facts_and_observations.restriction: These are search guards and probe triggers, not bans on vcmxmul, wide vectors or unrolling.

portability: NONE. A new RTL digest or Venus generation imports only abstract hypotheses as unverified and must run new probes.
validation_backlog: Replay a focused partial-final-beat positive/negative test on RTL bf82d804
Build an independent minimal scratch store/load fence probe
Make the Scheduler descriptor/completion contract tests green through a separately approved infrastructure change
Bind every retained compiler failure to the exact compiler/toolchain digest
live_promotion: NOT_APPLICABLE; this profile is empirical backend-scoped evidence, not portable live guidance.
